limitations: Data Map does not specify all nullability, precision, indexes, triggers, tenant policy or Nest authentication semantics.
EF snapshot supplements only missing legacy field metadata; no EF-only columns or tables are introduced.
UUID normalization for new Trading IDs is a lab decision, not an in-place migration plan.
Filtered indexes, application triggers, row-level security and external textual FK comments require explicit review.
Authentication hashes from ASP.NET Identity are NOT Nest/Argon2 password hashes. Use fresh lab-only accounts.
